name: Vapin Ape Full Spectrum Pod Starter Kit | Animal Mints
description:
All Vapin Ape "Starter Kits" come with a Vapin Ape Pod System Battery.

This indica hybrid strain is cultivated by crossing Animal Cookies with Sinmint Cookies. This strain is high in calming terpenes like Myrcene, Terpinolene, and Caryophyllene that together create a strong body and head high, making it ideal for after work and evening use. This strain features a sweet, pungent aroma that is minty on the exhale. Taste & Aroma: Crisp mint, Menthol, Apple. Effect: Relieved, Relaxed, Euphoric
